**Udviklingsmål** (Development Goal) is a specific quality indicator standard used in the Danish healthcare system to assess the safety and effectiveness of treatment for patients with [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]]. Published by [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]], this normative standard is specifically tied to Indicator 6, which tracks the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|intracranial bleeding]] among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. The primary purpose of the Udviklingsmål is to determine whether the clinical prevention of severe bleeding complications meets the desired national quality threshold [^src1].

For Indicator 6, the Udviklingsmål is strictly defined as ≤ 0.6% (or ≤ 0.6 per 100 risk years) [^src1]. This benchmark is evaluated across specific reporting periods, including previous cycles in 2022/23 and 2023/24, and the current reporting period spanning from July 1, 2024, to June 30, 2025 [^src1]. The metric plays a critical role in the broader 'Atrieflimren i Danmark' quality development program, helping authorities evaluate the impact of treatment strategies—such as the shift from Marevan to DOACs—and consider demographic adjustments like age standardization [^src1].

In the most recent assessment, the data showed that exactly 0.6% of prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation were admitted to the hospital with intracranial bleeding during the reporting period [^src1]. Consequently, the Udviklingsmål of ≤ 0.6% was officially recorded as fulfilled [^src1].
